mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM reserve r WHERE r.customer_id = (SELECT c.id FROM customer c WHERE c.username = #{username})

SELECT DISTINCT dt.* FROM dining_table dt JOIN reserve r ON r.dining_table_id = dt.id WHERE (r.start_time <= #{startTime} AND r.end_time > #{startTime}) OR (r.start_time < #{endTime} AND r.end_time >= #{endTime}) OR (r.start_time >= #{startTime} AND r.end_time <= #{endTime})
SELECT MAX(CAST(no AS SIGNED)) FROM reserve
SELECT * FROM reserve WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reserve (no, insert_time, start_time, end_time, customer_id, dining_table_id) VALUES (#{no}, #{insertTime}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{customer.id}, #{diningTable.id})
